sections.subhead: Turn Ad Spend Into Qualified Leads, Not Wasted Clicks

body.html: Teknoppy is a Google Ads management company in Kochi for businesses that spend on ads but cannot see what is working. We run Search, Shopping and Performance Max campaigns end to end, with weekly optimisation so ad spend converts into real enquiries rather than clicks that lead nowhere. Our PPC management across Search, Shopping and Performance Max applies continuous testing and negative-keyword refinement.

Choosing the right Google Ads agency matters because Google Ads punishes neglect quickly — poorly optimised campaigns waste budget within days, not months, which is why ongoing management matters more here than almost any other marketing channel.

sections.h2: What Our Google Ads Management Includes

items.title: Campaign Setup & Structure
items.html: We build your account structure correctly from the start — proper campaign segmentation, tightly themed ad groups, negative-keyword lists, and location radius targeting around Kochi and Ernakulam that sets up everything to perform.

items.title: Search & Shopping Campaigns
items.html: Search ads target high-intent buyers actively searching for what you offer with sitelinks and call assets, while Google Shopping ads and Merchant Center feed management put your products directly in front of buyers comparing options.

items.title: Landing Pages & Conversion Tracking
items.html: We ensure clicks land on dedicated landing pages built to convert, and configure conversion and call tracking so every enquiry, phone call or purchase is accurately measured.

items.title: Remarketing & Performance Max
items.html: Remarketing campaigns re-engage visitors who did not convert the first time, while Performance Max campaigns combine search, display, Maps and YouTube with smart bidding once conversion volume supports it.

items.title: Account Audit or Setup
items.text: Our Google Ads audit reviews existing campaigns for wasted spend and missed opportunities, or a fresh account is built correctly from scratch.

items.title: Keyword & Audience Research
items.text: Search terms and audience targeting are researched against real buyer intent, not broad guesses.

items.title: Campaign Build & Launch
items.text: Campaigns are structured, budgets set, and conversion tracking confirmed working before spend begins at scale.

items.title: Ongoing Optimization
items.text: Google Ads budget optimization happens weekly, adjusting bids, pausing underperformers, and reallocating spend toward what's converting.

items.title: Reporting & Review
items.text: Monthly reporting walks through what worked, what didn't, and where budget moves next.

items.html: We optimize weekly, not quarterly. Google Ads campaigns drift fast — we catch wasted spend before it compounds into a wasted month.

sections.h2: Other digital marketing services in Kochi
Frequently Asked Questions — Google Ads Management in Kochi

items.q: How much should I budget for Google Ads?
items.a: Most small Kochi businesses start with Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 40,000 per month in ad spend, plus our management fee from Rs. 10,000/month. Competitive fields like real estate or healthcare usually need higher budgets. We recommend a starting budget after a free keyword and competitor review.

items.q: Who owns the Google Ads account?
items.a: You do. All campaigns, ad history, and billing profiles are created under your business account with full administrator access. Teknoppy manages the campaigns with delegated partner permissions.

items.q: How soon will I see results from Google Ads?
items.a: Traffic and clicks begin within hours of campaign launch. A stable, cost-effective cost per lead is usually reached within 4 to 8 weeks of continuous weekly bid optimisation, negative keyword pruning, and ad testing.

items.q: How is Google Ads different from SEO?
items.a: Google Ads delivers immediate visibility through paid placements at the top of search results, while SEO builds organic rankings over months. Most businesses benefit from running both in tandem.

items.q: Can you audit our existing Google Ads account?
items.a: Yes. Our free Google Ads audit reviews your current campaigns for wasted ad spend, negative keyword gaps, tracking errors, and landing page quality, with a written action plan.

items.q: Do you set up conversion and call tracking?
items.a: Yes. We configure conversion tracking, form submissions, and phone call tracking in Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager before spend begins, ensuring every lead is accounted for.

items.q: What is the difference between Search, Shopping, and Performance Max?
items.a: Search ads target people actively typing commercial search queries. Shopping ads showcase retail products with images and prices. Performance Max uses Google automated bidding across Search, Maps, YouTube, and Display simultaneously.

items.q: Is there a minimum contract period?
items.a: Our Google Ads management runs month to month with a recommended 3-month initial period to allow sufficient time for data collection, conversion optimisation, and bid scaling.
